_about: Reference answers computed with sqlite3 from testdata/golden.sql against shop.db (sha256 88f3625a18bd482a7fa7cfca5a338ee2ecb1c6e585fdab310e90de54d50e8498). Default revenue rule: SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) over orders with status != 'cancelled'.

q3_top_country.reason: No country column. Only proxy: all 150 phone numbers use the +7 country code (Russia/Kazakhstan numbering plan).

q5_note: Ranks 4-6 tie at 83 units; tie broken by revenue DESC. Rank 6 is product 17 'Фен профессиональный' (83 units, 455670.0).

q7_revenue_2025.note: All orders are dated 2026-02-17..2026-08-22. For reference, 2026 revenue = 28134150.0 over 648 non-cancelled orders.
